newsitem.title: USA: IRS head Margaret Richardson to leave post - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: IRS head Margaret Richardson to leave post - WSJ.

text.p: Margaret Milner Richardson, who has been IRS commissioner since May 1993, will leave the post after this year's tax filing season, unless her successor is confirmed first, The Wall Street Journal reported on Wednesday.
The paper said the 53-year-old former tax lawyer had already informed President Bill Clinton of her intention to leave the IRS.
